verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Zep ingests JSON, text, business data, and documents into the Context Graph, not just chat messages (zep-docs-2, zep-docs-27), with API examples for graph operations and custom entity/edge types for structuring business data. Community context confirms the underlying Graphiti engine tracks facts/entities beyond raw transcripts. Missing for 10: no hands-on independent verification of ingesting large documents or complex JSON schemas at scale, and no detail on supported document formats (PDF, etc.).
